q1_exact_configuration.interpretation: Family of similar configs, not identical instances. 7/9 fields shared; 2 vary but judgment remains consistent.

distance.structural_boundary: dist>20 introduces counterexamples in structural-only grouping
distance.conclusion: ALLOWED within semantic family; BOUNDARY INDICATOR for structural-only

x_overlap.conclusion: ALLOWED within semantic family; XO=False lower YES rate structurally

ce2.difference: SEMANTIC_DIFFERENCE (CRITICAL: ALL fields identical including case_type, different judgment)
ce2.significance: DECISIVE — proves evidence cannot determine judgment for ambiguous cases

ce4.analysis_note: Could be caption or reference — semantic ambiguity

q3_counterexample_root_cause.decisive_case: CE2: identical evidence + same case_type → different judgment (NO vs YES)

q4_grouping_without_semantic_label.interpretation: Structural-only grouping cannot achieve stable family. case_type (semantic label) is required for 100% consistency.

reasons_not_low: No structural threshold cleanly separates YES from NO

conditions: case_type (semantic label) needed for clean separation
semantic content needed for ambiguous cases (CE2 proof)
structural boundary unclear (no threshold separates YES from NO)
blockers: Semantic label dependency: family requires case_type (not structural)
Evidence cannot determine judgment: CE2 proves identical evidence → different judgment
G5 boundary confirmed: ambiguous cases require semantic interpretation

g5_convergent_validation.finding: G5 Semantic Boundary independently re-confirmed through Evidence Configuration Family analysis
g5_convergent_validation.original_path: Evidence Boundary Structure Research (13 G5 cases in academic corpus)
g5_convergent_validation.new_path: CE2 in Evidence Configuration Family Research (identical evidence → different judgment)
g5_convergent_validation.convergence: Both paths arrive at same boundary: structural evidence has ceiling; semantic identity cannot be determined from structure alone
g5_convergent_validation.implication: Evidence Configuration Family is bounded by G5. Within non-ambiguous cases, family is stable. At ambiguous boundary, G5 prevents structural resolution.

limitations.limitation: SINGLE HUMAN REVIEWER — CE2 distinction may be reviewer-specific
CE2 IS DECISIVE BUT SINGLE INSTANCE — more pairs would strengthen finding
STRUCTURAL BOUNDARY UNTESTED AT FINER GRAIN — but CE2 suggests fine-grain won't help
SAME DOMAIN — all academic papers, cross-domain untested
